how many / how much 与数量表达: how many 接可数名词复数,how much 接不可数名词;how much 还可问价格。
how many + 可数复数:How many books?|how much + 不可数:How much water?|how much 问价格:How much is it?|a lot of / lots of 既接可数也接不可数|many/few 配可数,much/little 配不可数|some 肯定句,any 疑问否定(呼应 g-114)
How many students are there in your class?
How much milk do you need?

# title: How ___ eggs do we have left?
There isn't ___ water in the bottle.
column4: water 不可数,否定句用 much。

# title: I have ___ friends here, so I never feel lonely.
column4: friends 可数,肯定句用 a lot of。

# title: Hurry up! We only have ___ time.
column4: time 不可数,肯定含义用 a little。

# title: ___ bottles of juice shall we buy?
column4: bottles 可数复数,用 How many。
